post.description: Accepts a member invite and signs in (the HttpOnly session cookie). With `user` and `code` (the code from the invite email), the code sets the first password and verifies the email; an account someone else registered without proving the email has its old password replaced and every session ended. With `email` (an existing account, from the invite notice), the account's own password signs in and no password is set. The link's token `t` must match an open invite. A removed member's ban is lifted only then; any other ban is `member_suspended`. If a step after the code fails, the error is `invite_incomplete` with `error.accept_ticket`: send it back in place of `code`, with the same password, to finish. A weak password is refused before the code is used.

200.description: Signed in: `studio` with the session cookie set (or `pending`, with none)

400.description: The body is malformed, or the link, code or ticket is wrong, used or closed (`invalid_request`), or the password is too weak (`weak_password`; nothing was used)

401.description: With `email`: the email or password is wrong (`invalid_credentials`)

403.description: The account is banned outside Chelabase, or the member is suspended (`member_suspended`): no sign-in

410.description: The invite expired (`invite_expired`) or its account is gone (`invite_revoked`)

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

422.description: The body is JSON but has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The identity service or the orchestrator is unavailable (`unavailable`), or a step after the code failed (`invite_incomplete`, with `accept_ticket`)

post.description: Changes the signed-in user's email (needs the `Chelabase-User` token). With verification on, a code is emailed and the email is unverified until `verify-email`.

401.description: No user token (`user_token_invalid`), or no valid public key (`unauthorized`)

409.description: The email is taken (`email_taken`), it is the user's email already (`conflict`), or app users are off (`app_users_disabled`)

503.description: The identity service or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Changes the signed-in user's password (needs the `Chelabase-User` token) and returns a new session; every other session of the user ends.

401.description: The current password is wrong (`invalid_credentials`), no user token (`user_token_invalid`), or no valid public key (`unauthorized`)

422.description: The new password is weak (`weak_password`), or the body has the wrong fields (`invalid_request`)

503.description: The identity service or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

get.description: The public keys app access tokens are signed with, so an app's own server can verify them. Needs no key.

503.description: App users are not configured: `unavailable`

post.description: Emails a password-reset code. Answers the same whether or not the account exists.

422.description: The body has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Sets a new password with the emailed reset code and ends every session of the user.

422.description: The code is wrong (`invalid_code`), the password is weak (`weak_password`), or the body has the wrong fields (`invalid_request`)

503.description: The identity service or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new session. The old refresh token stops working (presenting it again later revokes the session).

401.description: The refresh token is invalid (`refresh_token_invalid`) or was used already (`refresh_token_reused`; the session is revoked), or no valid public key (`unauthorized`)

403.description: The user is deactivated or locked: `user_inactive`

422.description: The body has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The identity service or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Emails the verification code again. Answers the same whether or not the account exists.

422.description: The body has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Signs an app user in with email and password.

401.description: Wrong email or password (`invalid_credentials`), or no valid public key (`unauthorized`)

403.description: The email isn't verified (`email_not_verified`) or the user is deactivated or locked (`user_inactive`)

422.description: The body has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The identity service or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Ends the session of the `Chelabase-User` token, or, without one, the session of the refresh token in the body.

401.description: Neither a user token nor a refresh token (`user_token_invalid`), or no valid public key (`unauthorized`)

422.description: The body has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Creates an app user and their users-table row. With email verification off, signs them in; with it on, emails a code and returns no tokens.

201.description: Signed up: a session (verification off) or a pending sign-up (verification on)

409.description: App users are off (`app_users_disabled`), or the email is taken and verification is off (`email_taken`)

422.description: Invalid input (`invalid_request`), a weak password (`weak_password`), a `data` column sign-up can't set (`unknown_column`) or a table constraint (`constraint_violation`)

503.description: The identity service, the orchestrator or the database is unavailable: `unavailable`

get.description: The signed-in app user (needs the `Chelabase-User` token).

401.description: No user token (`user_token_invalid`), or no valid public key (`unauthorized`)

503.description: The identity service or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Marks the email verified with the emailed code.

422.description: The code is wrong or expired (`invalid_code`), or the body has the wrong fields (`invalid_request`)

503.description: The identity service or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

get.description: Whether this instance is unclaimed, so the sign-up page asks for the setup code, and whether it takes sign-ups, so the sign-in page offers one. Sets no cookie.

503.description: The sign-up gate is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Describes an open invite for the accept page: who invited the visitor, and to which workspace. The invite link's own token (`t`) is the credential, so this spends no code. It is a POST so that the user id and the token are never in a URL. A closed (accepted, revoked or expired) invite, a wrong or missing user or token, and a malformed value all answer the same `not_found`.

200.description: The invite is open and the token matches

400.description: The body is not well-formed JSON: `invalid_request`

404.description: `not_found`: no open invite with this user and token

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

503.description: The orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Revokes the session and clears the HttpOnly session and step cookies. If the identity service can't be reached the cookies stay, so the client can try again.

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

422.description: The body is JSON but has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The identity service is unavailable: `unavailable`; the session is still live

post.description: Emails a password-reset code if the account exists, in the background. Always answers the same, in the same padded time, whether or not it does. At most 5 codes go out per person an hour.

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

422.description: The body is JSON but has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

post.description: Sets a new password with the code from the reset email, verifies the email and ends every session of the account. A wrong code and an unknown email answer alike. Sets no cookie: sign in with the new password.

400.description: The body is malformed (`invalid_request`), the password is too weak (`weak_password`; the code is not used) or the code is wrong (`invalid_code`)

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

422.description: The body is JSON but has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The identity service is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Sends the verification code again. Reads the HttpOnly step cookie. Always answers the same, whether or not a code was sent; at most 5 codes go out per person an hour.

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

422.description: The body is JSON but has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

post.description: Signs in with email and password. `studio` sets the HttpOnly session cookie, which seals the identity session and the tenant. `verify` sets the HttpOnly step cookie that the code step reads. `pending` sets no cookie: an admin hasn't approved this person yet. A wrong password, an unknown email and no active membership answer alike.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description:
The tenant's id. Needed to sign in to one of several; `/auth/v1/token` refuses any
but the session's. Never trusted: it is checked against the memberships.

401.description: Wrong email or password, no active membership, or a `tenant` this person isn't a member of: `invalid_credentials`

409.description: The credentials are right and this person has several tenants: `tenant_required`, with their ids in `error.tenants`. Sign in again with `?tenant=`

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

422.description: The body is JSON but has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The identity service or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Creates an account: the fresh-install admin with the setup code, otherwise a person waiting for an admin's approval. With email verification off it signs them in, so the answer is `studio` (the session cookie) or `pending` (no cookie). With it on, `verify` and the HttpOnly step cookie that the code step reads.

400.description: The body is malformed, a name is blank or over 200 characters, or the identity service refuses a field (`invalid_request`), or the password is too weak (`weak_password`)

403.description: Sign-up is closed for this instance (`sign_up_closed`), the unclaimed instance needs its setup code and it is missing or wrong (`setup_code_invalid`; no account is created), or not available in platform mode (`not_available_in_platform_mode`)

409.description: An account with this email exists (`email_taken`); only when email verification is off

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

422.description: The body is JSON but has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The identity service or the sign-up gate is unavailable: `unavailable`

get.description: Studio's runtime config: the API URL and Studio's host. Public; cacheable for 60 s.

post.description: Mints a member access token from the HttpOnly session cookie, after checking that the identity session is live and younger than 30 days and that the membership is active. Takes no body. Studio must send `Origin` and `X-Chelabase-Studio: 1`. Never cached.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description:
The tenant's id. Needed to sign in to one of several; `/auth/v1/token` refuses any
but the session's. Never trusted: it is checked against the memberships.

200.description: The token, for the tenant the session is bound to

401.description: No live session, an older one, another tenant, or no active membership there: `unauthorized`

429.description: Over 120 a minute for this session: `rate_limited`

503.description: The identity service or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Checks the emailed code. Reads the HttpOnly step cookie and clears it once the email is verified. An open sign-up joins its tenant now, as a person waiting for approval. The answer is a sign-in's: `studio` sets the HttpOnly session cookie, `pending` sets none. If sign-up closed since the account was made, the answer is `sign_up_closed` and the account is deleted. A retry after a failure past the code finishes with the same code.

200.description: Email verified: `studio` (the session cookie is set) or `pending`; the step cookie is cleared

400.description: The body is malformed (`invalid_request`) or the code is wrong (`invalid_code`)

403.description: Sign-up closed since the account was made: `sign_up_closed`; the account is deleted

409.description: The person has several tenants: `tenant_required`, with their ids in `error.tenants`; sign in with `?tenant=`

410.description: This sign-in has expired or is unknown: `sign_in_expired`

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

422.description: The body is JSON but has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The identity service or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`; the step stays

AcceptInviteBody.description:
One of three shapes: `user` + `code` (a new person, or an account nobody proved: the code sets
the first password), `user` + `acceptTicket` (a retry after the code was spent), or `email`
(an existing account, from the code-less notice: `password` is its own). `t` is always the
link's token.

acceptTicket.description:
From an `invite_incomplete` error: finishes the steps after the (spent) code. Send it in
place of `code`, with the same password.

code.description: The six-digit invite code from the invite email, or from the admin's link.

email.description: An existing account's email (the notice's link carries only `t`).

password.description: The new password with `code` or `acceptTicket`; the account's own with `email`.

user.description: The invitee's identity user id, from a code link (`?user=`).

AppJwks.description: The app token signing keys (JWKS, RFC 7517).

AppSession.description: A signed-in session: a short-lived access token and the refresh token that renews it.

data.description:
Values for the users table's own columns. Only columns with
`GRANT INSERT (column) ON <users table> TO authenticated` are accepted.

AppSignUpPending.description: A sign-up that waits for the emailed code: no tokens yet.

AppSignUpResult.description: Sign-up's answer: a session (verification off) or a pending sign-up (verification on).

AppUser.description: An app user as the flows show them.

code.description: The six-digit code from the reset email.

DescribeInviteBody.description: Both fields default to empty, so a missing one is a `not_found` like a wrong one.

t.description: The invite token from the invite link.

user.description: The identity user id from the invite link.

ErrorBody.description:
The documented shape of the `error` object. Some codes add extra keys (for example
`keys`), which are documented per code.

ErrorCode.description: Stable, machine-readable error code. Serialises as snake_case.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The schema error responses reference: `{"error": ErrorBody}`.

InstanceInfo.description: What the sign-up page needs to know about this instance.

setupRequired.description:
The instance is unclaimed (its tenant has no member yet): the first sign-up needs the
setup code that `chelabase-init secrets` printed. `false` once anyone is in, without a
configured code (then no first sign-up is taken at all), and in platform mode.

signUpAllowed.description:
Whether the sign-in page offers "Create account": sign-up is open, or the unclaimed
instance waits for its first account. `false` in platform mode.

InviteDescription.description: Who invited the visitor and to what.

inviter_name.description:
The inviter's display name; their email's local part when they have none; `An admin` with
neither (a machine user).

tenant_name.description: The workspace the invite is to.

SignInStep.description: Where a sign-in or sign-up goes next.

setupCode.description:
The setup code that `chelabase-init secrets` printed: the first sign-up of an unclaimed
instance needs it (case and dashes don't matter). Ignored once the instance is claimed.

StudioConfig.description:
Studio's runtime config: the public values it starts with. Nothing else is here (no PAT, key
or secret): it is public and cached.
